description: This file contains classes and functions related to managing TLS configurations and fingerprint probing for gateway connections, including certificate pinning and TLS handshake procedures.

classes.name: GatewayTlsParams
classes.description: Data class representing parameters for TLS configuration, including fingerprint expectations and allowance for trust-on-first-use (TOFU).

classes.name: GatewayTlsConfig
classes.description: Data class encapsulating SSL socket factory, trust manager, and hostname verifier for TLS connections.

classes.name: GatewayTlsProbeFailure
classes.description: Enum indicating failure reasons during TLS fingerprint probing, such as TLS unavailability or unreachable endpoint.

classes.name: GatewayTlsProbeResult
classes.description: Data class holding the result of a TLS fingerprint probe, including the SHA256 fingerprint and failure details if any.

methods.name: buildGatewayTlsConfig
methods.description: Constructs a TLS configuration object based on provided parameters, including certificate pinning and hostname verification.

methods.name: probeGatewayTlsFingerprint
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous TLS handshake to obtain the server's certificate fingerprint, handling various error cases.
